meta.title: Workspace launch defaults
meta.description: Remembers the agent preset and the provider, model, and reasoning effort used in each working directory, then applies them again to that workspace's next newly created or cold-resumed blank session. Run a preset, or pick a model, anywhere in a workspace and the next newly created or cold-resumed blank session there starts with the same choices; other workspaces keep their own. Only blank sessions are changed, a non-default preset named on purpose by the session creator is left alone, subagent sessions are always ignored, and forks are ignored by default (they participate when skipForks is false). A live blank session reused within the same process is handled directly by the Host and the plugin does not re-apply its memory. A turn on the configured default preset counts as no preference so that workspace keeps following the default. Memory is stored on this host in the plugin's own storage domain, not in the session log; turning the plugin off stops both remembering and applying but keeps the stored values.
